description: Detection refuses to invent a gap from unusable geometry. A short line's own median is contaminated by the very gap being looked for, so a three-character line reports nothing even with a doubled interval. Every character on one pixel has a median spacing of zero. A line below the minimum emitted-character count cannot form a spacing pair at all. Char boxes that do not cover the text are not geometry, and boxes beyond the text are ignored rather than mismatched.
